# Beleg — E-Rechnung Deutschland

> Deine E-Rechnung-Pflicht, auf den Tag genau. Educational tool (not tax advice).
> URL: https://beleg.attenciona.com/
> Language: German (de) · Audience: German businesses, freelancers, Kleinunternehmer
> Verified: 13 August 2026

## What this tool does
A 3-question browser-only checker that returns your exact German E-Rechnung obligations:
- Receive e-invoices: mandatory since 01.01.2025 (in force, no exceptions, incl. Kleinunternehmer §19 UStG)
- Issue e-invoices: from 01.01.2027 for businesses with prior-year turnover > EUR 800,000; from 01.01.2028 for all others
- Kleinunternehmer (§19 UStG): exempt from issuing, still must receive
- Formats: XRechnung, ZUGFeRD 2.0.1+, Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (all EN 16931)
- Checklist: format choice, validation, GoBD archiving (8 years, unaltered XML)
- Risks: loss of input VAT deduction for the recipient; fines up to EUR 5,000 (incl. §26a UStG); §379 AO up to EUR 25,000

## Facts with sources
- Receive obligation since 01.01.2025; issue 01.01.2027 (>800k) / 01.01.2028 (all): https://www.vatupdate.com/2026/07/21/germany-e-invoicing-b2b-mandate-timeline-and-compliance/
- European Commission overview: https://ec.europa.eu/digital-building-blocks/sites/spaces/DIGITAL/pages/467108886/eInvoicing+in+Germany
- SME deadlines: https://www.hamburger-software.de/blog/artikel/e-rechnung-2027-was-kmu-jetzt-wissen-und-tun-sollten
- Fines §26a UStG up to EUR 5,000: https://www.ihp-media.com/ratgeber/e-rechnung-pflicht-2027-unternehmen-800000-euro/
- Formats & exceptions: https://www.cleartax.com/de/e-rechnung
